Interface NotifierSpi

All Known Implementing Classes:
HazelcastNotifierSpi, InMemoryNotifier, NatsNotifierSpi, PostgresNotifierSpi, RabbitMqNotifierSpi, RedisNotifierSpi, SnsNotifierSpi
public interface NotifierSpi
Backend SPI for opaque byte[] notification broadcasting.

The SPI is a single broadcast channel. All type-awareness, routing, and fan-out logic is handled by DefaultNotifier, which wraps this SPI. Backend implementations only need to transport opaque byte arrays.

Implementations must be thread-safe.

  • Method Details

    • notify

      void notify(byte[] payload)
      Broadcasts an opaque payload to all current subscribers. Best-effort — there is no delivery guarantee.
      Parameters:
      payload - the encoded notification bytes

    • subscribe

      NotifierSubscription subscribe(Consumer<byte[]> handler)
      Registers a handler to receive all broadcast payloads. Returns a NotifierSubscription that can be cancelled to stop receiving notifications.
      Parameters:
      handler - the handler to invoke for each payload
      Returns:
      a subscription handle that can be cancelled
